Manifesto

Care is split, expensive, and left for you to coordinate.

More than a third of Americans skip the care they need because of cost. Those who can pay get it in pieces: a dietitian who never sees the training plan, a coach who never sees the labs, a doctor who sees neither.

Nobody is watching the whole picture, so the person left coordinating it is the patient. Without a fundamentally new approach, that gap only widens. Below is the team working on it.
